note: Round three. Subject and camera are matched inside each pair exactly as in round two — every entry keeps its round-two eye height, aim height, standoff and field of view, and the `ab3-` block in tools/shoot.mjs is generated from the `ab2-` one so they cannot drift. Two things change. The renderer changed: heads, skin, cloth, shield bosses and armour. And the **trial structure** changed, which is the more important of the two — this deck is built with `--isolate`, so each pair is a self-contained directory to be graded by one grader in a fresh context who sees nothing else. Fourteen pairs shown to one grader are one trial with thirteen confirmations; fourteen graders shown one pair each are fourteen trials, and only the second has any resolving power between 100% and 50%. The hour schedule is also re-spread — round two's spanned 8.6 to 17.6 with three twelve-minute collisions, this one spans 7.3 to 17.7 with a half-hour floor. Rome II side is one of the twenty-two official store screenshots in reference/rome2-steam; see its SOURCES.md for the URL of each. Four of the twenty-two are campaign-map shots with the full interface up and are never eligible.
